nodes.name: SMS Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives incoming SMS data from MacroDroid. Expected body: { sender: string, message: string, timestamp: string }

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-haiku-4-5-20241022",
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "system": "You are a family life assistant analyzing incoming text messages for a busy parent. The parent's family context:
- Co-parent: Josh
- Daughter: Emma, attends St. Patrick School
- The parent manages family calendars, school events, sports, and social activities.

Analyze this text message and respond with ONLY a JSON object (no markdown, no code blocks):
{
  "relevant": true/false (is this about family scheduling, events, kids, school, activities, or something the parent needs to act on?),
  "category": "invitation|schedule_change|reminder|info|school|sports|medical|social|spam|casual",
  "summary": "one clear sentence summarizing what this is about",
  "priority": "high|medium|low",
  "has_event": true/false,
  "event_details": { "title": "...", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD or natural language", "time": "HH:MM or natural language", "location": "..." } (only if has_event is true),
  "suggested_actions": ["list of actions like: add_to_calendar, notify_josh, rsvp, set_reminder, none"],
  "needs_response": true/false (does the sender expect a reply?),
  "response_deadline": "date or null if mentioned in the message"
}

Be smart about detecting events even from casual language. 'Want to grab lunch Tuesday?' is an event. 'Lily's party Saturday at 2' is an event. 'k sounds good' is casual.",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": {{ JSON.stringify($json.promptText) }}}]
}

={
  "source": "sms",
  "from": {{ JSON.stringify($json.sender) }},
  "subject": {{ JSON.stringify($json.category) }},
  "summary": {{ JSON.stringify($json.summary) }},
  "category": {{ JSON.stringify($json.category) }},
  "priority": {{ JSON.stringify($json.priority) }},
  "event_details": {{ JSON.stringify($json.event_details || null) }},
  "suggested_actions": {{ JSON.stringify($json.suggested_actions || []) }},
  "original_message": {{ JSON.stringify($json.message) }},
  "notify_josh": {{ $json.suggested_actions?.includes('notify_josh') || false }}
}
